news.title: Tollywood Faces Major Financial Hurdles Amid Changing OTT Dynamics
news.summary: The Telugu film industry is confronting a significant financial shift as streaming platforms drastically cut budgets and refuse inflated acquisition prices. This correction is forcing filmmakers to rethink production costs and prioritize genuine box-office viability.
